stick.name: Leek

auspicious-armor.name: Auspicious Armor
auspicious-armor.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Charcadet → Armarouge. Consumed only on successful evolution.
auspicious-armor.flavorText: An old set of golden armor, treasured for its fine craftsmanship.

black-augurite.name: Black Augurite
black-augurite.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Scyther → Kleavor. Consumed only on successful evolution.

chipped-pot.name: Chipped Pot
chipped-pot.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Sinistea Antique → Polteageist Antique. Consumed only on successful evolution.
chipped-pot.flavorText: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokemon evolve. It may be chipped, but tea poured from it is delicious.

cracked-pot.name: Cracked Pot
cracked-pot.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Sinistea → Polteageist. Consumed only on successful evolution.
cracked-pot.flavorText: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokemon evolve. It may be cracked, but tea poured from it is delicious.

dawn-stone.name: Dawn Stone
dawn-stone.shortDesc: Use on male Kirlia for Gallade or female Snorunt for Froslass. Consumed only on successful evolution.
dawn-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokemon evolve. It sparkles like a glittering eye.

deep-sea-scale.name: Deep Sea Scale
deep-sea-scale.shortDesc: When held, doubles Clamperl's Sp. Def. Use to evolve: Clamperl → Gorebyss. Consumed only on successful evolution.
deep-sea-scale.flavorText: An item to be held by Clamperl. This scale shines with a faint pink and raises the holders Sp. Def stat.

deep-sea-tooth.name: Deep Sea Tooth
deep-sea-tooth.shortDesc: When held, doubles Clamperl's Sp. Atk. Use to evolve: Clamperl → Huntail. Consumed only on successful evolution.
deep-sea-tooth.flavorText: An item to be held by Clamperl. This fang gleams a sharp silver and raises the holders Sp. Atk stat.

dragon-scale.name: Dragon Scale
dragon-scale.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Seadra → Kingdra. Consumed only on successful evolution.
dragon-scale.flavorText: A very tough and inflexible scale. Dragon-type Pokemon may be holding this item when caught.

dubious-disc.name: Dubious Disc
dubious-disc.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Porygon2 → Porygon-Z. Consumed only on successful evolution.
dubious-disc.flavorText: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.

dusk-stone.name: Dusk Stone
dusk-stone.shortDesc: Use on a compatible Pokémon to evolve it. Consumed only on successful evolution.
dusk-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokemon evolve. It holds shadows as dark as can be.

electirizer.name: Electirizer
electirizer.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Electabuzz → Electivire. Consumed only on successful evolution.
electirizer.flavorText: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. Its loved by a certain Pokemon.

fire-stone.name: Fire Stone
fire-stone.shortDesc: Use on a compatible Pokémon to evolve it. Consumed only on successful evolution.
fire-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokemon evolve. The stone has a fiery orange heart.

galarica-cuff.name: Galarica Cuff
galarica-cuff.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Slowpoke Galar → Slowbro Galar. Consumed only on successful evolution.
galarica-cuff.flavorText: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokemon very happy.

galarica-wreath.name: Galarica Wreath
galarica-wreath.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Slowpoke Galar → Slowking Galar. Consumed only on successful evolution.
galarica-wreath.flavorText: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokemon very happy.

ice-stone.name: Ice Stone
ice-stone.shortDesc: Use on a compatible Pokémon to evolve it. Consumed only on successful evolution.
ice-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokemon evolve. It has an unmistakable snowflake pattern.

kings-rock.name: Kings Rock
kings-rock.shortDesc: When held, adds a 10% flinch chance to eligible damaging moves. Use to evolve: Poliwhirl → Politoed; Slowpoke → Slowking. Consumed only on successful evolution.
kings-rock.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokemon. When the holder successfully inflicts damage, the target may also flinch.

leaf-stone.name: Leaf Stone
leaf-stone.shortDesc: Use on a compatible Pokémon to evolve it. Consumed only on successful evolution.
leaf-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokemon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern.

linking-cord.name: Linking Cord
linking-cord.shortDesc: Use on compatible trade-evolving Pokémon. Karrablast and Shelmet require a real trade with each other. Consumed only on successful evolution.
linking-cord.flavorText: A cable with plugs at both ends, used to connect devices.

magmarizer.name: Magmarizer
magmarizer.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Magmar → Magmortar. Consumed only on successful evolution.
magmarizer.flavorText: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. Its loved by a certain Pokemon.

malicious-armor.name: Malicious Armor

malicious-armor.flavorText: An old set of dark armor with a mysterious, unsettling presence.

masterpiece-teacup.name: Masterpiece Teacup

masterpiece-teacup.flavorText: A finely crafted teacup with an elegant finish.

metal-alloy.name: Metal Alloy
metal-alloy.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Duraludon → Archaludon. Consumed only on successful evolution.
metal-alloy.flavorText: A sturdy alloy made by combining different metals.

metal-coat.name: Metal Coat
metal-coat.shortDesc: When held, boosts Steel-type moves. Use to evolve: Onix → Steelix; Scyther → Scizor. Consumed only on successful evolution.
metal-coat.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokemon. Its a special metallic film that can boost the power of Steel-type moves.

moon-stone.name: Moon Stone
moon-stone.shortDesc: Use on a compatible Pokémon to evolve it. Consumed only on successful evolution.

oval-stone.name: Oval Stone

oval-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokemon evolve. Its as round as a Pokemon Egg.

prism-scale.name: Prism Scale
prism-scale.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Feebas → Milotic. Consumed only on successful evolution.

protector.name: Protector

protector.flavorText: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. Its loved by a certain Pokemon.

razor-claw.name: Razor Claw

razor-claw.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokemon. This sharply hooked claw increases the holders critical-hit ratio.

razor-fang.name: Razor Fang
razor-fang.shortDesc: When held, adds a 10% flinch chance to eligible damaging moves. Have Gligar hold it and level up at night (21:00–05:00 game time) to evolve into Gliscor. Consumed only on successful evolution.
razor-fang.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokemon. When the holder successfully inflicts damage, the target may also flinch.

reaper-cloth.name: Reaper Cloth
reaper-cloth.shortDesc: Use to evolve: Dusclops → Dusknoir. Consumed only on successful evolution.
reaper-cloth.flavorText: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. Its loved by a certain Pokemon.
